kind: posthoc provenance-driven challenge design, before any challenge model predictions
reason: Existing character-matched controls have differing token lengths; existing external identifiers are separable by both length rules.
eligibility: Same repository and upstream revision, at least two distinct whole-file scopes selected by logged commands with uniquely linked tool responses.
Neither selected file was created by that trajectory agent; verify both in the pinned upstream Git tree before freezing.
Paired identifiers must have identical character length and identical token count in the pinned Harrier tokenizer.
Known rendered inputs must also have identical whole-state and whole-memory token lengths within each repository/template.
selection: Eligible pools ordered by first source row; first three new repositories. Within pool select lexicographically first eligible scope pair, keeping actual command/response evidence.
model_selection: Keep existing dev-based architecture/checkpoint selection. Do not tune using this challenge.
